translation: Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine), myrrh (沒藥), acanthopanax (五加皮), mirabilite (皮硝), green tangerine peel (青皮), Sichuan pepper (川椒), cyperus (香附子, each three qian), clove (丁香, one qian), musk (麝香, one fen), old scallion (老蔥, three roots), lycium bark (地骨皮, one qian), moutan bark (丹皮, two qian). Boil in water until rolling, fumigate and wash the affected area. <ins>Wu Long Ointment (烏龍膏)</ins> This ointment treats injuries from falls and blows, broken sinews and fractured bones, and hard swelling that is blue-purple. Plant soot (百草霜, three qian), bletilla (白及, five qian), ampelopsis (白蘞, three qian), lily (百合, five qian), stemona (百部, three qian), frankincense (乳香, five qian), myrrh (沒藥, five qian), musk (麝香, one fen), glutinous rice (糯米, stir-fried, one liang), aged flour powder (陳粉子, last year's is best, stir-fried, four liang). Grind all together into a fine powder, boil with vinegar into an ointment.
